mapper.select: /* common.mdsr.selectMasterMdSrSrCmsDetailPop */ SELECT A.SR_NO AS SR_NO, DECODE (A.RECV_FLAG, 'GA', '요청', 'GS', '요청취소', 'DS', '상신', 'PS', '처리중', 'PA', '처리완료', 'PB', '보류처리', 'GG', '완료') AS RECV_TEXT, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR01' AND CODE = A.SYS_TYPE) AS SYS_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR02' AND CODE = A.REQ_TYPE) || (SELECT ' / ' || TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR05' AND CODE = A.REQ_SR_TYPE) AS REQ_TEXT, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REQ_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS REQ_TIME, TO_CHAR (A.PH_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PH_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.PH_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS PH_TIME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID) AS REQ_CONFIRM_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CD_USER_ID) AS CD_USER_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DP_USER_ID) AS DP_USER_NAME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.CD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS CD_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.CD_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS CD_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.DP_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS DP_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.DP_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS DP_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.DS_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS DS_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.DS_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS DS_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.FF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS FF_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.FF_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS FF_TIME, NVL (TO_CHAR (A.DF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), '') AS DF_DATE, TO_CHAR (A.DF_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS DF_TIME, A.REQ_REMARK AS REQ_REMARK, A.REQ_ATTKEY, A.USER_ID AS USER_ID, A.RECV_FLAG AS RECV_FLAG, A.REQ_CONFIRM_ID AS REQ_CONFIRM_ID, A.FF_ATTKEY AS FF_ATTKEY, A.DS_REMARK AS DS_REMARK, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DS_USER_ID) DS_USER_NAME, A.DF_REMARK AS DF_REMARK, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR03' AND CODE = A.RUB_TYPE) AS RUB_TEXT, A.RUB_REMARK AS RUB_REMARK, A.DS_USER_ID AS DS_USER_ID, TO_CHAR (A.REQ_CONFIRM_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS REQ_CONFIRM_TIME, A.SR_FLAG AS SR_FLAG, A.SR_SUBJECT, A.REQ_TYPE, A.REQ_SR_TYPE, (SELECT MAX(TARGET) FROM ICOMTRGW WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND DOC_NAME = 'SR' AND KEY_1 = A.SR_NO) AS DOCU_NO FROM KEPASRDT A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{st_sr_user_id} AND A.SR_NO = #{st_sr_no}
mapper.update: /* common.mdsr.updateMasterMdSrSrCmsDetailPopPS */ UPDATE KEPASRDT A SET A.DS_USER_ID = #{st_ds_user_id}, A.DP_DATE = TO_DATE (TO_CHAR (SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), A.DP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, A.DS_REMARK = #{st_ds_remark}, A.REQ_TYPE = #{st_req_type}, A.REQ_SR_TYPE = #{st_req_sr_type}, A.RECV_FLAG = 'PS' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{st_sr_user_id} AND A.SR_NO = #{st_sr_no}

/* common.mdsr.mailMasterMdSrSrCmsDetailPop */ INSERT INTO MAILSEND ( MAILFORM_ID, SEND_COM_TYPE, RECV_COM_TYPE, SEND_COM_CODE, SEND_USER_ID, KEY1, KEY2, KEY3, KEY4, KEY5, KEY6, CRE_DATE ) VALUES ( 'SR_DS_RQ_MM', 'M', 'M', #{st_ds_com_code}, #{st_ds_user_id}, #{st_sr_user_id}, #{st_sr_no}, ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )

/* common.mdsr.historyInsertSWMGBUGTD */ INSERT INTO SWMG.BUGTD (APPNAME, BUGTYPE, ISPUB, EFFECT, ENVRAM, DETAIL, WORKPLAN, PRIORITY, STATUS, POSTTIME, POSTEMID, ASSIGNEMID, REQTIME, ISREJECT, DIFFCULTY, EMPID, SYSTEM_ID, IJOB_ID) SELECT (SELECT MT.APPNAME FROM SWMG.APPMT MT, SWMG.APPMATCHMT CHMT WHERE MT.APPID = CHMT.APPID AND CHMT.SSCODE = A.SYS_TYPE AND CHMT.IJOBCODE = A.REQ_TYPE) AS APPNAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SR02' AND CODE = REQ_TYPE) AS BUGTYPE, 0 AS ISPUB, SR_NO || '(' || (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) || ') 의한 작업 요청' AS EFFECT, 0 AS ENVRAM, REQ_REMARK AS DETAIL, DS_REMARK AS WORKPALN, 1 AS PRIORITY, 0 AS STATUS, SYSDATE AS POSTTIME, (SELECT EMID FROM SWMG.EMPLOYEEMT WHERE EMCODE = CD_USER_ID) AS POSTEMID, (SELECT EMID FROM SWMG.EMPLOYEEMT WHERE EMCODE = CD_USER_ID) AS ASSIGNEMID, REQ_DATE AS REQTIME, 0 AS ISREJECT, 0 AS DIFFCULTY, 0 AS EMPID, SYS_TYPE, REQ_TYPE FROM KEPASRDT A WHERE USER_ID = #{st_sr_user_id} AND SR_NO = #{st_sr_no} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM SWMG.BUGTD B WHERE A.SR_NO = SUBSTR (B.EFFECT, 1, 10)) AND SR_FLAG = 'N'
